programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: Not only does Valentine Casey have trouble escaping his past, but also when it comes to visit him, it's usually with guns blazing. As the steadfast upholder of the law in the 1900s Arizona, Valentine leads a good life in a small town -- which unfortunately comes to a halt when his no-good family arrives and kills some innocent people. After moving to a new place and trying to restart things, pursuing a woman named Adaline along the way, his clan tracks him down again.

programme.title: Promise
programme.desc: A retired Union contract scout embarks on a deadly mission to find out what happened to his true love and her little girl.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Hot Spur
programme.desc: A stable hand kidnaps the wife of a ranch owner to avenge the rape of his sister.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell

programme.title: Shotgun
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun.

programme.title: Driftin' River
programme.desc: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name.

But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

programme.title: Along the Navajo Trail
programme.desc: Gypsies help a U.S. deputy marshal (Roy Rogers) pose as a singing drifter and bust an oil syndicate.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety.

programme.title: Hot Spur

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: Outlaws of the Plains
programme.desc: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area.

programme.title: Romance of the West
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Sweetest Thing
programme.desc: When it comes to dating, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) has a golden rule: avoid searching for Mr. Right and focus on Mr. Right Now. That is until one night at a club when she unexpectedly meets Peter (Thomas Jane), only to see him suddenly disappear the next day. She and her best friend Courtney (Christina Applegate) decide to break the rules and go on a road trip to find him, encountering wild and hilarious misadventures along the way.

programme.title: A Slipping-Down Life
programme.desc: "Drumstrings" Casey (Guy Pearce) is an aspiring rock musician, though he hasn't had much success so far. Evie Decker (Lili Taylor) is likewise searching for direction and meaning. She works at an amusement park by day and at night bides her time alongside her troubled father. Between the two, Evie might be the more emotionally disturbed, as evidenced by how obsessed she becomes with Casey -- going so far as to carve his name across her forehead. They get married, but can their love last?

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.sub-title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.
